message.content: {"rules":["Implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must ensure that the iterator's size_hint is exact.","Implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must ensure that the iterator's size_hint is cheap to call.","Implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must not override TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size.","All subtypes and all supertypes of Self must also implement TrustedRandomAccess. In particular, implementations for types with non-invariant parameters usually cannot depend on trait bounds on those parameters, except bounds from the respective struct/enum definition or bounds involving traits with a similar subtype/supertype implementation guarantee.","If Self: ExactSizeIterator, self.len() must always produce results consistent with self.size().","If Self: Iterator, implementors must ensure that <Self as Iterator>::__iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) is safe to call when all of these conditions hold: 0 <= idx < self.size(); if Self: !Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; after the call, next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times, with this limit calculated individually for self and each clone when Self: Clone, but with next_back() calls before cloning counting for both; after the call, only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size are called on self or any new clones. Coercion from Self to a supertype T, including multiple successive coercions, is permitted; after an unchecked access, the same method restriction applies to every resulting value, and unchecked-access counts for each index and next_back() counts are added across self and all successive coercion results and must remain within the stated bounds.","If Self: Iterator, __iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) must not change the value returned by size_hint when all of these conditions hold: 0 <= idx < self.size(); if Self: !Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; after the call, next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times, with this limit calculated individually for self and each clone when Self: Clone, but with next_back() calls before cloning counting for both; after the call, only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size are called on self or any new clones. Coercion from Self to a supertype T, including multiple successive coercions, is permitted; after an unchecked access, the same method restriction applies to every resulting value, and unchecked-access counts for each index and next_back() counts are added across self and all successive coercion results and must remain within the stated bounds.","If Self: Iterator, after __iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx), it must be safe to call Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size on self, assuming their required traits are implemented, when all of these conditions hold: 0 <= idx < self.size(); if Self: !Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; after the unchecked call, next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times, with this limit calculated individually for self and each clone when Self: Clone, but with next_back() calls before cloning counting for both; after the unchecked call, only those six methods are called on self or any new clones. Coercion from Self to a supertype T, including multiple successive coercions, is permitted; after an unchecked access, the same method restriction applies to every resulting value, and unchecked-access counts for each index and next_back() counts are added across self and all successive coercion results and must remain within the stated bounds.","If Self: Iterator, it must be safe to drop self after __iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) when all of these conditions hold: 0 <= idx < self.size(); if Self: !Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; after the call, next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times, with this limit calculated individually for self and each clone when Self: Clone, but with next_back() calls before cloning counting for both; after the call, only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size are called on self or any new clones. Coercion from Self to a supertype T, including multiple successive coercions, is permitted; after an unchecked access, the same method restriction applies to every resulting value, and unchecked-access counts for each index and next_back() counts are added across self and all successive coercion results and must remain within the stated bounds.","If Self: Iterator and Self is a subtype of T, it must be safe to coerce self to T after __iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) when all of these conditions hold: 0 <= idx < self.size(); if Self: !Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; after the call, next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times, with this limit calculated individually for self and each clone when Self: Clone, but with next_back() calls before cloning counting for both; after the call, only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size are called on self or any new clones. Multiple successive coercions to supertypes are permitted; after an unchecked access, the same method restriction applies to every resulting value, and unchecked-access counts for each index and next_back() counts are added across self and all successive coercion results and must remain within the stated bounds."]}
